{{Top}}
'''Shellfish''' were small sea creatures. The largest of the shellfish native to the tropical [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Anantapar/Legends|Anantapar]] could fit inside the palm of a [[Human/Legends|Human]] hand.<ref name="Gazetteer">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040325web|text=Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin|int=Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin}}</ref> Shellfish came in a variety of colors, including green,<ref name="Truce at Bakura">''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''</ref> and were even painted for display.<ref name="Survivor's Quest">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref> Additionally, most of their species were edible by [[Human/Legends|Humans]],<ref name="Truce at Bakura" /> though shellfish from [[Pamina Prime]] weren't; ingesting them could cause a fatal disease called [[Borotavi syndrome]].

The [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] evolved strong teeth to crush shellfish, which became a staple of their diet.<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref> Naboo shellfish were served as an appetizer at the [[Indigo Tower]] and was one of [[Haydnat Treen]]'s favorite dishes.

Some individuals believed rotten shellfish could cause hallucinations.<ref name="Outbound Flight">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>

The [[Sedrian]]s of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]] used shellfish as components to create their unique [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapons.]]<ref name="BGS">''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]''</ref>
